newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian inflation unchanged at 0.3 pct in week.
newsitem.headline: Russian inflation unchanged at 0.3 pct in week.

text.p: Russian inflation is estimated at 0.3 percent in the week ended June 16, unchanged from the previous week, the State Statistics Committee said on Thursday.

If current price trends continue, monthly inflation for the whole of June will be 1.1 percent, and the inflation rate from January to June will be 8.6 percent, the committee said. The monthly inflation rate in May was 0.9 percent.
The committee issued the following estimates:
Percentage change in week ended June 16 June 9
Basket of 37 basic goods and services +0.3 +0.7
Basket of 37 basic goods and services +0.042 +0.076
The committee does not formally collate weekly inflation data, but estimates the weekly trend on the basis of the prices of 37 basic goods and services.
